integrity: Finite exact DAG census and independent witness reachability checks in standalone verify.py; no independent external mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Mathematical site-reliability model; the five-vertex bound holds for all directed graphs but the six-vertex profile classification only for DAGs. Perfect protection, fixed edges, and independent survival are assumed. Generic joint reliability importance is established prior work; specialized historical priority remains provisional. No empirical conservation efficacy claim.
title: A sharp six-vertex threshold for protection-complementarity reversal in directed habitat networks
